label: Collection mapping (Search)
type: the per-collection top-level mapping. Shares its static/dynamic option set with search:object-mapping and search:xattrs-mapping.
evidence: You can also choose to control the type of a document by setting a type identifier.
For more information about how to create a type mapping in the standard editor, see Create a Type Mapping.
relates_to_competency_question: What is the default mapping scope for a collection within a Search index, before any type or child mapping narrows it?
